content.comment_body: Hello, I can't connect my [product_name] to the demo version of [product_name] for transferring my program. The 'transfer PC to device' button is also disabled.
With the demo version of [product_name], transferring programs or monitoring them online is not supported. These transfer features are only available in the full version.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have identified a significant limitation in the demo version of [product_name]: program transfer to the hardware is not permitted. This restricts users from fully testing or evaluating all of the software’s capabilities in real-world scenarios.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the demo version of [product_name] should enable program transfers and connectivity with hardware, allowing for comprehensive evaluation before purchasing.
